title: Chapter 328 Ayub'S Breakthrough On The Battlefield
content:
Chapter 328 Ayub'S Breakthrough On The Battlefield

A red lightning bolt flew out along the long sword and hit Ayub directly.

Wang Shuo's face darkened, and he became nervous, his heart in his throat.

Ayub had no time to defend and dodge.

Ayub, who was hit by the lightning, was flashing with arcs all over his body. He should have been seriously injured, but at this time, he was miraculously standing.

He closed his eyes, and the lightning on his body slowly disappeared, as if it was slowly absorbed. After a while, it disappeared without a trace.

"Huh!"

The Thunder Skeleton King was surprised.

He also stopped attacking at this time, looking at the changes in Ayub's body, and became a little curious.

Not long after, Ayub's body was covered with lightning again, but it was purple. The purple lightning gradually covered his whole body, and then slowly turned red.

The same color as the lightning shot by the Thunder Skeleton King.

Then, Ayub suddenly opened his eyes, with murderous intent in his eyes.

Wang Shuo was surprised, did he break through again?

It was the same last time. After being seriously injured, he realized the Lightning Rising Dragon Strike.

Could it be that this time, with the help of the red thunder, he broke through again?

Ayub held the Qinglong Sword in his hand and waved it in front of him. His momentum suddenly increased, and he shouted: "I am the God of War - Ayub, die for me!"

As soon as the voice fell, he jumped into the air and slashed with a sword. The Qinglong Sword was wrapped in red lightning, exactly the same as the Thunder Skeleton King just now.

This sword carried the power of wind and thunder, as if it had the power to split the sky and the earth.

The Thunder Skeleton King did not dare to be arrogant. He held the sword in one hand and grabbed the tip of the sword with the other hand, raising the sword above his head to resist this thunder-like blow.

"Keng."

Sparks flew, metal and iron rang, and lightning flashed.

The Thunder Skeleton King was actually knocked down to the city by a blow.

This -

Can you believe it?

Wang Shuo rubbed his eyes, his face full of shock and disbelief.

The other generals around were also stunned, their jaws dropped in surprise.

Wang Shuo quickly checked Ayub's information.

Under the stimulation of thunder and lightning, he actually broke through the fifth level of "Thunder Spear Technique" and also comprehended a skill - Breaking the Sky.

Not only that, what subverted Wang Shuo's cognition was that he actually broke through the bottleneck of high-level generals and entered the ranks of top generals.

This change directly subverted Wang Shuo's cognition.

In his understanding, generals can only use general transfer orders to upgrade their levels.

But Ayub's breakthrough made Wang Shuo confused.

Could it be that breaking through the limit by himself is the correct way to open it?

Without time to think about it, Wang Shuo retracted his thoughts.

Because at this time, the Thunder Skeleton King climbed up again.

"Hehe, hehe..."

"Human, you are very good! You are qualified to fight me."

Wang Shuo wanted to curse in his heart.

"You are a general, and Ayub's attack was obviously the strongest, you just blocked it casually."

"Isn't this qualification too hasty?"

The Thunder Skeleton King jumped down from the battlement and rushed towards Ayub.

With the long knife in his hand, he took Ayub's head.

"Everyone, come together!"

Wang Shuo's words awakened everyone. This is an extremely powerful boss.

Compared with the alien beasts, the health value of humanoid creatures of the same level may not be higher, but the combat power is really strong.

Obviously, the bones of this Thunder Skeleton King are very tough, and the health value is not inferior to the alien beast generals of the same level.

It can be said that there is no weakness.
